NARRATIVE AND PLANS
FOR THE PROPOSED ZONING AMENDMENT TYPE 1.

6333-35 N. Mozart Avenue

The subject property contains a 32’-0” x 124’-0” vacant lot. The applicant seeks to
rezone the subject property from an RT4 Residential Two-Flat Townhouse and Multti-
Unit District to an RM5 Residential Multi-Unit District. The apptication is for a Type 1
Map Amendment in order to allow the construction of a 3-story 8-dwelling unit
building with a basement, with 4-rear parking spaces, and 8-bicycle spaces. The
subject property is in a TSL Transit-Served Location within 1,320 feet of a CTA bus line
corridor (the 155 Devon bus).

PROJECT BULK AND DENSITY
Use: @-Residential Dwelling units
LOTAREA: 32’ x 124'=3,968 square feet

FLOOR AREA RATIO: 1.70

BUILDING FLOOR AREA: 6,468 square feet

MIN. LOT AREA/DWELLING UNIT: 496 square feet
OFF-STREET PARKING SPACES: = 4

BICYCLE SPACES: 8

FRONT SETBACK: 11'-8”

REAR SETBACK: 29 feet

REARYARD OPEN SPACE: To be located more than 4 feet above ground (roof deck).
SIDE SETBACK: 3feetNorth 3'-6” South

BUILDING HEIGHT. 36 Feet

ADMINISTRATIVE ADJUSTMENTS: 17-13-1000, 17-13-1003-1,17-13-1003-3,17-13-1003-K,17-13-
1003-EE,17-13-1003-R.

The project is in a Transit Served Location (TOD) located within 1,320 feet of the CTA bus line
corridor roadway segment (155 Devon Bus).

47-13-1100, 17-13-1101-A, 17-13-1101-B, 17-13-1101-D, variations are also sought for setback
raductions and are seeking all Zoning relief as needed and as allowed by the Chicago Zoning
Code.
